name: HYDRA-UMC-STUDIO
notes: Web control dashboard with 3D multi-robot visualization, talking to HYDRA-UMC-SERVER's own API. Found live in production: the debounced POST /api/settings save (and flushSettingsSave()/factoryReset()) used `fetch(...).catch(() => {})`, which only catches a real network failure - a 401 (expired session) or 403 (non-admin role) response was never checked, so a save could silently no-op forever while the local UI still showed the new value (a camera toggled off in Vision Center kept its real Server-side stream process running, burning CPU; toggling it back on then showed nothing). All three paths now check response.ok, surface a real settingsSaveError instead of pretending to succeed, and only mark a payload as sent once it actually was; a new "Save failed - Retry" indicator next to the System Online/Offline badge surfaces this immediately with a one-click retry. HYDRA-UMC SUITE's own push_state() already did this correctly - this was a STUDIO-only gap.
